posts.text: Come out for the last week of the year!

If you have never been to USDGC/TPWDGC (Oct 8-11) at Winthrop University in Rock Hill, SC, here is your chance to win 4 - 4 Day “Friends and Family” Passes (same access as VIP Passes)! @[100004392703089:2048:Chris Kowalski] has donated them. All proceeds will go to fund additional long tee pads at Wilderness Ridge DGC at Wilderness Presidential Resort. 

Tickets are $5 each. You can send PayPal to spotsydiscgolfclub@gmail.com

This Thursday night, Spotsy league will be held at loriella park, this week is only for players that had played any division at least 10 weeks, it is free to play with normal payouts. Please check in by 5:30 PM. We will need to get going as soon as we can as daylight is getting shorter.
FYI… We are moving the check-in time and start time forward 15 minutes due to the fading sunlight.

# ***Are You Ready for LoCo Open?!!***
## **COME ON OUT - YOU WON'T BE DISAPPOINTED, I PROMISE!** 

Throwing at Flying Ace Brewery, taking on a championship level wooded track At Clark's Run or hang out with your Friends at Hal & Berni Park. This event will not disappoint. We will likely also see some lead up events making it even more of a carnival atmosphere. 

Massively epic Ace pots at stake, a fair amount of shenanigans, just a great atmosphere. Come for the laughs and make some new friends.

Event is the weekend of Oct 2 thru 4.

Pros: Oct 3/4

You can register at:

[https://www.discgolfscene.com/tournaments/Fifteenth_Annual_LoCo_Open_Ams_2026](https://www.discgolfscene.com/tournaments/Fifteenth_Annual_LoCo_Open_Ams_2026)
